about: Blind re-score of the community view after round 8 (19 Oct 2026): the land is the USDA NAIP 2022 aerial photo. Three critics (art director, terrain realism, mobile UX), each flaw checked by a skeptic, plus a before/after judge against the round 7 shots (set1 = round 8, set2 = round 7; the judge did not know which). Anchors as round 7: 10 indistinguishable from a commissioned photoreal aerial, 8 buyer-ready premium, 7 high quality with a few tells, 6 competent but game-like in places, 5 a technical map/GIS rendering, 3 broken. Note: the round 7 phone and landscape shots were taken after the credits text had changed, so their credits line already names the photo.

confirmed_flaws.issue: Close up the photo is a soft green smear with no grass or rock detail: 0.5 m imagery magnified (3 critics, confirmed).
Context houses are untextured grey or salmon hipped boxes beside the detailed Nā Hiku models (3 critics, confirmed; carried over from round 7).
Blob crowns on thin trunks; one crown at about 660,280 shows no trunk or contact shadow (partly confirmed; no tree clearly floats).
Bunkers read as flat pale grey decals, no warm sand tone or lip (2 critics, confirmed). The grade toward green had made the photo's white sand grey-green; pale photo ground is now warmed toward sand.
The modelled access road is a flat grey strip that ends square in grass at both ends (confirmed; carried over).
Billboard cloud puffs and a ruler-straight sea horizon at y about 265 (3 critics; horizon confirmed, cloud style a taste call; carried over).
Open ocean is a smooth navy gradient with no wave texture or glint (confirmed; carried over).
The harbour basin is a milky turquoise wash with a hard white shore rim (confirmed; unchanged from round 7, drawn sea).
In 844x390 the notice's last letters run under 'The home' (confirmed; also in round 7). Fixed: tighter letter spacing on landscape phones.
Photo structures and woods with no 3D counterpart lie flat on the ground beside 3D trees and boxes (partly confirmed).
Place pills about 24-26 px tall, dots about 10 px (confirmed; carried over).
Phone credits about 8 px; Credits chip about 42x14 px (partly: small, not low-contrast).

before_after.per_view: 10 of 12 views prefer round 8; phone/3-home-close a tie; desk/3-home-close prefers round 7 (crisp drawn fairways and paths against a soft photo up close).
key_differences: Round 8's photo ground reads as real Kauaʻi; round 7's drawn ground has hard-edged brown patches that look game-like.
Round 7's drawn golf (stripes, cart paths) is crisper up close, where the photo turns soft.
Round 8 credits the photo consistently at every width.
